definitions.explanation: A dark area produced by blocking light.
The outline of a person or thing.
An image seen in water or a mirror.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}の{影|かげ}を{見|み}た。
{木|き}の{影|かげ}が{地面|じめん}に{映|うつ}っている。
examples.english: The shadow of the tree is cast on the ground.

examples.japanese: {夕方|ゆうがた}になると、{影|かげ}が{長|なが}く{伸|の}びる。
examples.english: In the evening, shadows grow long.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{影|かげ}も{見|み}えない。
examples.english: There's no sign of him at all.

examples.japanese: {暗|くら}い{道|みち}の{向|む}こうに、{誰|だれ}かの{影|かげ}が{動|うご}いているのが{見|み}えた。
examples.english: I could see someone's figure moving at the far end of the dark road.

examples.japanese: {水|みず}に{影|かげ}が{映|うつ}る。
examples.english: A reflection appears on the water.

examples.japanese: {湖|みずうみ}に{山|やま}の{影|かげ}が{映|うつ}っていた。
examples.english: The reflection of the mountain was visible on the lake.

examples.japanese: {風|かぜ}がやんで{水面|すいめん}が{静|しず}かになると、{木々|きぎ}の{影|かげ}がくっきりと{映|うつ}った。
examples.english: When the wind died down and the water became still, the reflections of the trees appeared clearly.

notes:
{影|かげ} refers to shadows and silhouettes.

COMPARE:
- {影|かげ}: shadow, silhouette
- {陰|かげ}: shade, behind

EXPRESSIONS:
- {影|かげ}が{薄|うす}い: to have little presence
- {影|かげ}を{潜|ひそ}める: to hide, to disappear

COMPOUNDS:
- {影響|えいきょう}: influence
- {人影|ひとかげ}: figure of a person
